info.title: Port_Access_Cached_Client
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

applied_role.description:
Reference Resource: [Port_Access_Role](#/Port_Access_Role)
Role associated with this client.

auth_attributes.description: The RADIUS attributes cached for the client.  Outer key: the `attribute_id` is derived from a combination of            RADIUS attribute type and the vendor ID separated by a            `:`.            For standard attribute types, the vendor ID is 0.             Example: For standard attribute `Egress-VLAN-Name`            with type 58, attribute_id will be 58:0.            For vendor specific attributes from Aruba (Vendor-ID            14823) such as `aruba-user-role` and            `aruba-cppm-user-role` the attribute_id will be            26:14823.  Inner key: the `vendor_type_instance` is derived from a            combination of the vendor type associated with a            RADIUS attribute and the nth instance of the            attribute appearing in the same RADIUS message            separated by a `:`.            The value associated with this key is the value            received for that instance of the vendor type.            For standard attributes, the vendor_type is 0.             Example: For standard attribute `Egress-VLAN-Name`,            the first instance of this attribute in a RADIUS            message will have vendor_type_instance as 0:1, the            second instance (if exists) as 0:2 and so on.            For vendor specific attribute `aruba-user-role` with            vendor type 1, the first instance of this attribute in            a RADIUS message will have vendor_type_instance as            1:1, the second instance as 1:2 and so on.            For vendor specific attribute `aruba-cppm-user-role`            with vendor type 23, the first instance of this            attribute in a RADIUS message will have            vendor_type_instance as 23:1, the second instance as            23:2 and so on.

coa_attributes.description: The RADIUS attributes cached for the client via a Change Of Authorization (CoA) request.  Outer key: the `attribute_id` is derived from a combination of            RADIUS attribute type, vendor ID and the monotonic            clock time when the CoA request was processed            separated by a `:`.            For standard attribute types, the vendor ID is 0.             Example: For standard attribute `Egress-VLAN-Name`            with type 58, attribute_id will be 58:0:167602531114996.            For vendor specific attributes from Aruba (Vendor-ID            14823) such as `aruba-user-role` and            `aruba-cppm-user-role` the attribute_id will be            26:14823:167602531114996.  Inner key: the `vendor_type_instance` is derived from a            combination of the vendor type associated with a            RADIUS attribute and the nth instance of the            attribute appearing in the same RADIUS message            separated by a `:`.            The value associated with this key is the value            received for that instance of the vendor type.            For standard attributes, the vendor_type is 0.             Example: For standard attribute `Egress-VLAN-Name`,            the first instance of this attribute in a RADIUS            message will have vendor_type_instance as 0:1, the            second instance (if exists) as 0:2 and so on.            For vendor specific attribute `aruba-user-role` with            vendor type 1, the first instance of this attribute in            a RADIUS message will have vendor_type_instance as            1:1, the second instance as 1:2 and so on.            For vendor specific attribute `aruba-cppm-user-role`            with vendor type 23, the first instance of this            attribute in a RADIUS message will have            vendor_type_instance as 23:1, the second instance as            23:2 and so on.

creation_time.description: Time in seconds since epoch when this entry was created.

mac.description:
Reference Resource: [Port_Access_Cached_Client](#/Port_Access_Cached_Client)
MAC address of the client.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
